problem.title: Find Duplicate Files by Content
problem.problemStatement: You are given file paths along with their contents. Group together all files that have identical contents.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Next N lines each contain a file path followed by its content.
problem.output: Print each group of duplicate file paths.
